استحلفا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْلَفَا (istaḥlafā) /is.taħ.la.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# اُسْتُحْلِفَا (ustuḥlifā) /us.tuħ.li.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# اِسْتَحْلِفَا (istaḥlifā) /is.taħ.li.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
